issues.message: The sources disagree on the Y travel: 12 in in the Tool Room Mill's own addendum of 2/02 (p. 5 and p. 13), on the 2018 Toolroom sheet and on dealers' listings of 2006-07 units; 16 in on today's product page, pre-install guide and layout drawing (3/6/2023). 12 in is used: the 2002 addendum is Haas's own document of the TM-1 before this 11/06 unit, and today's pages describe today's enclosed TM-1 (docs/research/2026-11-11-haas-tm1-sources.md). Not measured on the machine.

The tool changer's 10 pockets are second-hand: a dealer's listing of a 2007 TM-1, and the 2018 sheet's 10-station carousel of today's TM-P (the 2018 TM-1 has none as standard). The photos show pockets numbered up to 9, about 36 degrees apart [INFERENCE]; the highest number was not photographed.
Which control this unit runs (Classic or Next Generation) is not confirmed: the pendant's keys match the 2009 Classic manual [INFERENCE]; read it off the screen at a visit (plan, visit list item 5).

Today's TM-1 pages (product page, pre-install guide, layout drawing) describe today's enclosed machine: 16 in of Y, 4440 lb shipping weight, a 47.8 in table. They are cited only where the 2006 unit's own sources say nothing: the axes' layout and the carousel's place (layout drawing, p. 4).
The operating dimensions (90 x 64 x 109 in) are the 2002 addendum's for the Tool Room Mill; whether they include the pendant's arm and the cable conduit is not stated.
